description: This file is a header (.h) defining interfaces and function prototypes for CCSP Message Bus interactions, including parameter management and session signaling, specific to a component within the CCSP framework.

methods.name: CcspCcMbi_GetParameterValues
methods.description: Retrieves the values of specified parameters from the message bus.

methods.name: CcspCcMbi_SetParameterValues
methods.description: Sets the values for specified parameters on the message bus.

methods.name: CcspCcMbi_SetCommit
methods.description: Commits or rolls back a set of parameter updates.

methods.name: CcspCcMbi_AddTblRow
methods.description: Adds a new row to a specified table object.

methods.name: CcspCcMbi_DeleteTblRow
methods.description: Deletes a row from a specified table object.

methods.name: CcspCcMbi_GetParameterNames
methods.description: Retrieves parameter names under a specified object.

methods.name: CcspCcMbi_CurrentSessionIdSignal
methods.description: Signals the current session ID with a specified priority.

methods.name: AccessControlBitMaskToAccessList
methods.description: Converts an access control bitmask to an access list string.

methods.name: AccessListToAccessControlBitMask
methods.description: Converts an access list string to an access control bitmask.

methods.name: MsgHelper_CreateCcdMbiIf
methods.description: Creates a CCSP message bus interface handle with a given D-Bus handle and prefix.
